Reducing $M$ to echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -5 & 6 \\ 3 & 10 & -12 & 14 \\ 2 & 3 & -19 & 15\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -5 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & 3 & -4 \\ 2 & 3 & -19 & 15\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -5 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & 3 & -4 \\ 0 & -3 & -9 & 3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+3{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -5 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & 3 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -9\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The corresponding system is now

$$
\{\begin{aligned}x+3y-5z=6 \\ 0x+y+3z=-4 \\ 0x+0y+0z=-9\end{aligned}
$$

Since there are no such numbers $x,y,z$ that form a solution of the final equation $0x+0y+0z=-9,$ we can conclude that our system has no solution.
